_comment: 复制为 devices.json 后再编辑。Docker 容器中需 bind 0.0.0.0 才能从宿主机访问；必须更换 token。此控制台可重启和控制手机，禁止暴露到公网。devices.json 不要提交到 Git。
_polling_comment: thermal_poll_seconds: how often battery/temperature is sampled. metrics_retention_days: how long those samples are kept in the local db. auto_open_on_reconnect: relaunch the processor app whenever a device comes back — leave false unless you know you want it.
_processor_comment: Which Acurast processor this console manages. Leave blank for the canary default.
_command_channel_comment: Signed readb/locate channel. Set the SAME value here and in the app (ENABLE_PROTECTION --es command_secret <same>). Blank = channel off. Also flip READB_ENABLED in fleet.py after your own operator-present test.
_updates_comment: Processor (Lite) OTA. enabled:false means the console only reports which version each phone runs; turn it on and it will also download and verify releases. It never installs one by itself — installing is always an action you take. expected_cert_sha256 is the signing cert the APK must match — set it from a release you have verified yourself, and an APK that does not match is refused.
_guardian_update_comment: Guardian APK rollout. keep_lite_foreground periodically nudges the processor back to the foreground if something stole it. opportunistic_update installs the target version ONLY on phones that are idle — installing on a phone holding a job can cost it that job, so it waits. Both default off here; batch/interval control how gently the rollout proceeds.
